content: चर {%a.%} (-री|{%f.%}) [चर्-अच्] .²1 Moving, going, walking, grazing <ab>&c.</ab>; धर्मारण्यचरेषु प्राणिषु <ls>Ś. 5. 9</ls>. .²2 Following, practising (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>). .²3 Trembling, shaking. .²4 Movable; see चराचर below; <ls>Ms. 3. 201</ls>; <ls>Bg. 13. 15</ls>. .²5 Animate; <ls>Ms. 5. 29</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">7. 15</ls>. .²6 (Used as an affix) formerly, late; आढ्यचर ‘one who was formerly rich’ so देवदत्तचर, अध्यापकचर late teacher <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-रः@} .²1 A spy. .²2 A wagtail. .²3 A game played with dice and men. .²4 A cowrie. .²5 The planet Mars. .²6 (Hence) Tuesday. .²7 The seventh Karaṇa in astrology. .²8 The Karaṇas taken collectively. .²9 The difference of time between two meridians. .²10 The first, fourth, seventh, and tenth signs of the zodiac. .²11 The wind; क्वाहं तमोमहदहंखचराग्निवार्भूसंवेष्टिताण्डघटसप्तवितस्तिकायः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 14. 11</ls>.
